asset.name: PinInput
asset.description: The fixed-length code field supporting paste, mobile input hints, optional masking, auto-advance, correction, and a single coherent screen-reader experience rather than one per box.

requires.reason: Sizing, spacing, and radius resolve to declared ramps rather than literals.
Controlled and uncontrolled operation share one contract and one event shape.

rationale: The accessibility trap is that a six-box code field naively announces six separate unlabelled inputs. Treating it as one field with one label is the whole point of having it in the catalog.
